text:
maya: Heads-up — planning to enable orion-quant-v2 in the catalog tomorrow during the 10:00–12:00 UTC change window. Canary -> scale plan below. Need final agreement on pin list and fallback ordering before we schedule the deploy-bot job.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy task created by @maya for 2026-04-10T10:00:00Z. Canary steps: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Auto-rollback thresholds: error_rate > 3% for 5m OR latency_p50 increase > 2x for 10m.
sam: quick Q — do we have any tokenizer or vocab changes between v1 and quant-v2? last time that caused inference mismatch for a couple customers.
ben: there is a minor tokenizer normalization tweak. It shouldn't affect most prompts, but it can shift token boundaries on punctuation-heavy inputs. Recommend pinning legacy variant for 7 days for customers with strict deterministic outputs.
lee: SLO ask — during canary we should keep 95th <= 300ms for short prompts. If breached, ops-oncall wants immediate drift alert and rollback.
ops-oncall: confirm. Our rollback runbook: manual rollback from eng-releases if alert triggers, auto-pin legacy if >2% user-facing diffs detected by QA harness.
devops: infra check — quant workers have spare capacity in us-west-2, eu-central. I'll reserve burst GPUs for the first 2 hours. Autoscaler stays enabled.
tia: metric checklist for canary: request success, request error, p50/p95 latency, token throughput, kv-cache hit rate, model_quality_regression_score against canary promptset. I'll post the PromQLs in a follow-up.
anisha: I'll draft the release note blurb and changelog entry. Proposal: "orion-quant-v2: improved throughput via 8-bit kernels; minor tokenizer normalization; recommended fallback: orion-v1 (pin), orion-quant-compat (compat variant), orion-quant-v2." Will share draft shortly.
sam: for the pin list, can we do per-customer pin policy? some enterprise customers need to stay pinned for 30 days.
maya: yes — catalog supports customer-scoped pins. Default: global pin to orion-v1 for 7 days after rollout, then allow auto-unpin. Add enterprise exceptions to the rollout ticket.
ben: small config snippet for fallback ordering — please prod it in CI before deploy:
```
model_catalog.fallbacks.orion: [
  {"name": "orion-v1", "priority": 1, "pin_duration": "7d"},
  {"name": "orion-quant-compat", "priority": 2},
  {"name": "orion-quant-v2", "priority": 3} 
]
```
lee: we should also add a runtime feature-flag to prefer quant-compat for low-latency routes for first 24h. Safer path.
maya: agreed — feature-flag gated rollout, enable_by_route: ["/chat/lowlatency"] initially.
deploy-ci: preflight checks passed: model checksum verified, quant kernels smoke tests OK, integration tests for tokenizer normalization passed on sample corpus.
ops-oncall: one more — define rollback signal clearly in the ticket: (1) auto-rollback if error_rate > 3% sustained for 5m; (2) manual rollback if human QA finds >5% semantic diffs for high-priority promptset; (3) immediate rollback on security/anom alerts.
devops: reserving extra logging retention for 12h post-deploy for deeper diffs.
tia: posting the PromQLs and alert rules in the #observability thread now.
anisha: release-notes draft: "orion-quant-v2 — production-ready quantized variant with kernel optimizations. Expect 20–40% token cost reduction. Minor tokenizer normalization may affect tokenization-sensitive clients; customers can pin orion-v1 for deterministic outputs."
maya: final checklist before we start the scheduled job:
- confirm fallback ordering (ben/maya) ✅
- add route feature-flag (lee) ✅
- preflight pass (deploy-ci) ✅
- reserve infra (devops) ✅
- release notes published (anisha) ✅
- ops rollback hooks configured (ops-oncall) ✅
If no objections, I will leave the scheduled task at 10:00 UTC.
sam: no objections from my side. I'll follow up with the enterprise success list for manual pins.
deploy-bot: Deploy job starting: orion-quant-v2 canary -> 1% traffic. Job id: db-20260410-241.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics after 6m: success_rate=99.7%, p95=210ms, token_throughput +30%, kv_cache_hit=0.82. No auto-rollback triggers.
maya: rolling to 10% now.
deploy-bot: 10% stable at 12m mark. p95=230ms, small uptick in tokenization diffs reported by QA: 0.9% on canary promptset. below manual threshold.
ben: monitoring logs for tokenizer edge cases, pushing a flag to map old tokens for flagged customers if needed.
maya: continuing to 50%.
deploy-bot: 50% ramp complete. p95=260ms, success_rate=99.5%. Ops: any objections to full cutover?
ops-oncall: thumbs — continue to 100% only if 95th <= 300ms for next 10m. otherwise roll back to orion-v1 pin.
maya: roll to 100%.
deploy-bot: Cutover complete. All routes active on orion-quant-v2.
anisha: publishing release notes and changelog entry now. pinging customers with known tokenizer sensitivity.
ops-oncall: closing the loop — no rollback needed. Marking post-deploy review for 24h.
maya: thanks everyone. I'll open a short postmortem ticket to capture the tokenizer diffs and any follow-ups.
